title: Week one review
listenFocus: Re-listen to a dialogue from this week
practiceFocus: Speak for 5 minutes entirely in Spanish

points.title: Nothing new
points.rule: Reuse only what you can already say. Soy and no soy for who you are. Es la una and son las for the time. Tengo, quiero, voy, and hago for what you have, want, and do. Mi and mis, then a matching ending, for people. If a sentence needs anything else, use a chunk you know.

grammar.notYet: Any new tense or verb. Today is for speaking, not a new chart.

phrases.spanish: Hola, me llamo… y soy de…
phrases.english: Hi, my name is… and I am from…
I am an engineer. I am not a doctor.
I am hungry and I want to eat.

phrases.spanish: Voy al restaurante con mis amigos.
phrases.english: I am going to the restaurant with my friends.
What do you want to drink?

phrases.spanish: Hasta luego. El sábado por la mañana.

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.spanish: Estoy bien. Hoy es domingo. Quiero ir a un café.
lines.english: I am well. Today is Sunday. I want to go to a café.

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.english: Let’s go. What do you want to eat?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.spanish: Una tostada y un café con leche.
lines.english: Toast and a coffee with milk.

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.spanish: Perfecto. Mi hermana vive cerca. Es muy simpática.
lines.english: Perfect. My sister lives nearby. She is very nice.

practice.title: Five minutes in Spanish
practice.instruction: Speak for five minutes without switching to English. Introduce yourself, then today, food, and family.
starters: Hola, me llamo Alex. Soy de Londres…
tips: Do not stop when you make a mistake. Keep speaking.
If you get stuck, repeat a phrase you already know.
